instrument_name: KW-100 Kansas Withholding Tax Guide (web edition, rates for wages paid on and after 2024-07-01; Wayback snapshot 2026-10-21)
authority: Kansas Department of Revenue
article_or_section: Withholding allowance amount; Tables for percentage method (Tables 1-8); Rounding; Supplemental wages; Nonresidents of Kansas; Filing frequencies; KW-3; W-2 state copy; Record format
figure_or_rule_carried: Percentage formula: gross per period minus allowance (annual 9,160 single/HoH/MFS, 18,320 MFJ, 2,320 per dependent and HoH extra; weekly 176.15 / 352.31 / 44.62); annual table single 0 to 3,605 = 0, 5.2% of excess over 3,605 to 26,605, then 1,196 + 5.58% over 26,605; married 0 to 8,240, 5.2% to 54,240, then 2,392 + 5.58%; weekly single 69 / 512 / 23.00, married 158 / 1,043 / 46.00; may round to nearest dollar; supplemental: same method as federal, 5% flat where federal flat used; other payments with federal % withholding: 5%; no K-4 -> single, no allowances (per US-KS-001). Filing: quad-monthly >100,000; semi-monthly 8,000.01-100,000; monthly 1,200.01-8,000; quarterly 200.01-1,200; annual <=200; KW-5 every period; KW-3 + W-2s + 1099s due Jan 31, KW-3 e-filed; >50 W-2 must e-file (EFW2 with Kansas RS per K-2MT, or KW-2CSV); records 3 years. Header of the percentage tables still reads 'For wages paid on and after January 1, 2021' but the figures are the SB 1 (2024) values.

instrument_name: KDOR Notice 25-06 Decreases of income and privilege tax rates contingent on revenue (2025-10-02)
authority: Kansas Department of Revenue, Policy and Research

instrument_name: KDOR Notice 26-11 Decreases of income and privilege tax rates contingent on revenue (2026-10-15)
authority: Kansas Department of Revenue, Policy and Research
figure_or_rule_carried: FY2026 adjusted GRF collections 6,104,030,438 vs inflation-adjusted base 6,318,369,802: short by 214,339,364; BSF 20.4%: no income tax rate reduction for tax year 2027 (5.2% / 5.58% continue)

instrument_name: K.S.A. 79-32,110 Tax imposed; schedules of tax rates
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Married joint: 5.2% not over 46,000; 2,392 + 5.58% over 46,000. Single/HoH/MFS: 5.2% not over 23,000; 1,196 + 5.58% over 23,000. Nonresident tax = resident-basis tax x modified Kansas source income / Kansas AGI

instrument_name: K.S.A. 79-32,119 Kansas standard deduction
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Standard deduction tax year 2024 and after: single 3,605; married 8,240; HoH 6,180 (fixed amounts, no indexation clause); additional (65+/blind) 850 single/HoH, 700 married. These are the zero-bracket thresholds of the KW-100 annual tables

instrument_name: K.S.A. 79-32,121 Kansas personal exemptions
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Tax year 2025 and after: MFJ 18,320; single/HoH/MFS 9,160; 2,320 per dependent; unborn child 2,320 (L. 2025 ch. 112). Fixed amounts, no indexation; basis of the K-4 allowance amounts

instrument_name: K.S.A. 79-3298 Withholding returns and remittance schedule
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: >100,000/yr: 4 periods ending 7th/15th/21st/last day, remit within 3 banking days if undeposited >= 667; 8,000-100,000: 1st-15th by 25th, rest by 10th of next month; 1,200-8,000: monthly by 15th; 200-1,200: quarterly by 25th of month after quarter; <=200: annual by Jan 25; annual return by Jan 31; frequency set on prior-year withholding

instrument_name: K.S.A. 44-1203 Minimum wage (Kansas Minimum Wage and Maximum Hours Law)
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Minimum wage 7.25/h from 2010-01-01 (no indexation, no scheduled increase); tipped cash wage 2.13/h with tip credit up to 7.25; does not apply to employers/employees covered by the FLSA (FLSA 7.25 governs them)

instrument_name: K.S.A. 44-1202 Minimum wage and maximum hours law; definitions
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer excludes FLSA-covered employers; employee excludes agriculture, domestic service in a private home, EAP and outside commission salesmen, federal employees, volunteers for nonprofits, persons 18 or under employed occasionally/part-time (<40 h/week; students between terms), USD EAP staff >=50%

instrument_name: K.S.A. 44-1204 Overtime compensation
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Non-FLSA employees: overtime at 1.5x regular rate after 46 hours in a workweek; EMS/fire/law enforcement 258 h per 28 days; excludes FLSA s.7-covered employees, non-manufacturer motor vehicle salespeople, inmates

instrument_name: K.S.A. 44-1209 Recordkeeping requirements
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Keep at least 3 years: name, occupation, rate of pay, amount paid each pay period, hours worked each day and week; FLSA-covered employers may keep FLSA records instead

instrument_name: K.S.A. 12-16,130 Local preemption: wage levels, paid benefits, scheduling
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: No city/county may require leave (paid or unpaid), pay for leave, wages above the minimum wage, benefits or scheduling changes beyond state/federal law (exception: economic development incentive programs). Basis for: no local minimum wage, no local paid sick leave in Kansas

instrument_name: K.S.A. 44-314 Pay periods; payment methods
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Pay at least once per calendar month on regular paydays designated in advance; pay period end not more than 15 days before payday; methods: cash, negotiable check, EFT to employee-designated account, payroll card; EFT-only employers must offer a default alternative; payroll card: one free full withdrawal per period, no fees; 30 days before EFT/card-only program: employee forum or educational information

instrument_name: K.S.A. 44-315 Separation prior to payday; damages for willful non-payment
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Discharge or resignation: earned wages due not later than the next regular payday (by mail if requested); willful non-payment penalty 1% of unpaid wages per day after the 8th day, capped at 100% of unpaid wages

instrument_name: K.S.A. 44-313 Definitions (wages) with Revisor case annotations on vacation pay
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Wages = compensation for labor or services less authorized deductions. Annotations: vacation pay due under an employment contract is wages (Benjamin v. Manpower, 3 Kan. App. 2d 657); no vacation pay where contractual condition (termination notice) unmet (Sweet v. Stormont Vail, 231 Kan. 604 (1982)); absent agreement no law requires payout of vacation time (Mid America Aerospace v. Dept. of Human Resources, 10 Kan. App. 2d 144 (1985)). Payout follows employer policy/contract

instrument_name: K.S.A. 44-319 Withholding of wages; deductions allowed
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Deductions only if required by law, medical care without employer benefit, signed employee authorization for employee benefit, or 401(k)/403(b)/408/408A/457 auto-enrolment (44-319a); signed written agreement for loan/advance repayment, overpayment, merchandise/uniforms; on final wages with written notice: unreturned employer property, loans, overpayment, merchandise; charity and union dues allowed; no deduction may reduce pay below FLSA or K.S.A. 44-1203 minimum wage

instrument_name: K.S.A. 60-2310 Wage garnishment restrictions
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Creditor garnishment: lesser of 25% of disposable earnings, excess over 30 x federal minimum hourly wage (30 x 7.25 = 217.50/week), or the claim; one garnishment per creditor per 30 days; debtor ill >2 weeks: suspended until 2 months after recovery; no limit for support, Chapter XIII bankruptcy, state/federal tax; support cap 50%/60% (+5% if arrears >12 weeks: 55%/65%)

instrument_name: K.S.A. 23-3104 and 23-3105 Income withholding for support: payor duties, fee, limit, priority
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Start withholding at the next pay after 14 days from service; remit within 7 business days of payday; employer fee lesser of 5 per pay period or 10 per month (lump sum up to 10 per withholding), in addition to support; total incl. fee and medical premiums capped at 50% of CCPA disposable earnings; contact IV-D agency 14 days before any lump-sum payment where arrears; notify termination; IWO has priority over all other process; multiple orders prorated, current support first

instrument_name: K.S.A. 75-5743 New hire reporting duty
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Report to the Secretary of Labor within 20 business days of hire, rehire or return to work (or of first wages): employee name, address, SSN, first day of work; employer name, address, FEIN and other 42 USC 653a data; newly hired includes re-employment after >=60 consecutive days of separation. KDOL page says 'within 20 days' (statute governs)

instrument_name: K.S.A. 44-703 Employment security law definitions (employer coverage, employment exclusions, wages, taxable wage base)
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Taxable wage base for rated groups 0-N11: 25% of prior-year statewide average annual wage rounded to nearest 100 for 2026-2027, 30% 2028, 35% 2029, 40% 2030-31, 40%/45% from 2032 (was 14,000 for 2016-2025); wages reported under another state's employment security law count toward the base ((o)(2)(C)(i)). Tips reported >=20/month are wages. Coverage: agricultural labor 20,000 cash per quarter or 10 workers in 20 weeks; domestic 1,000 cash per quarter. Excluded: family employment (spouse, child under 21), church/religious orders and ministers, student working for own school, newspaper delivery under 18, election workers <1,000

instrument_name: K.S.A. 44-704 Payment of benefits: maximum weekly benefit amount
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Max WBA = 55% of prior-year statewide average weekly wage, set each July 1; min WBA = 25% of max. Used only to re-derive the SAAW behind the 15,100 wage base (G-DERIVE)

instrument_name: KDOL Unemployment Tax page: FAQ (quarterly due dates, online filing threshold, EDI) - Wayback 2026-10-08
authority: Kansas Department of Labor
figure_or_rule_carried: Quarterly wage report and contribution return + payment due Apr 30, Jul 31, Oct 31, Jan 31; no reminder notices; FAQ: 26+ employees must file online, 25 or fewer may mail K-CNS-100; EDI section: from 2024-07-01 employers with 25+ employees or TPAs with 25+ client employees must e-file (threshold wording inconsistent on the same page); upload formats MMREF / NASWA; 0.00% rate group still reports wages

instrument_name: KDOL Employer Services page: rate table, WBA history, governmental rate 2027, New Hire Directory - Wayback 2026-10-16
authority: Kansas Department of Labor
article_or_section: Employer Tax Rates; Weekly Benefit Amount; Rated Governmental Employers; Kansas New Hire Directory Reporting
figure_or_rule_carried: 2026: Schedule C (HB 2570), 0%-6.95%, TWB 15,100, new 1.75%, new construction 5.55% (2025: Schedule B, 0%-6.65%, 14,000); max WBA 637 (2025-07-01) and 663 (2026-07-01), min 159 / 165; rated governmental 0.10% for 2025, 2026 and 2027; new hire within 20 days, multistate single-state election via HHS

instrument_name: K.S.A. 75-3520 Social security numbers: public documents and commercial use
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: No person may solicit, require or use an SSN for commercial purposes unless necessary in the normal course of business with no alternative identifier; exceptions incl. internal verification/administrative purposes and uses required by law; civil penalty up to 1,000 per violation. No Kansas statute located that mandates SSN truncation on pay statements (only 44-320 itemized deductions on request)

instrument_name: Form K-4 Kansas Employee's Withholding Allowance Certificate (Rev. 7-24)
authority: Kansas Department of Revenue
figure_or_rule_carried: Allowance rate Single or Joint (married with non-earning spouse = Joint; married with earning spouse = Single); no K-4 -> withhold at Single with no exemption; exempt status requires verifying with KDOR no liability last year and this year; status may differ from federal W-4

instrument_name: K-2MT Kansas W-2 Specifications for Electronic Filing, EFW2 format (Rev. 10-25, tax year 2025)
authority: Kansas Department of Revenue
article_or_section: Required records; Code RS layout (512 bytes)
figure_or_rule_carried: Kansas follows SSA EFW2 (K.S.A. 79-3222, 79-3296, 79-3299); required RA, RE, RW, RS (Kansas wages only), RT, RF; RO/RU/RV optional; RS record 512 bytes, all fields required (blank/zero filled); 51+ W-2s must be filed electronically; TY2025 W-2s due 2026-01-31; no magnetic media. TY2026 edition not yet located

instrument_name: Kansas Legislature SB 471 (2025-2026): increase Kansas minimum wage to 16/h and extend to FLSA-covered employers
authority: Kansas State Legislature
figure_or_rule_carried: Status: Died (end of 2025-2026 biennium). No change to the 7.25 Kansas minimum wage

instrument_name: K.S.A. 79-32,117 Kansas adjusted gross income of an individual; addition and subtraction modifications
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Kansas AGI = federal AGI with listed modifications (federal exclusions such as 401(k) deferrals, section 125, HSA, transit, group-term life flow through). Addition (b)(vi): designated employee contributions picked up by the employer under K.S.A. 12-5005, 20-2603, 74-4919, 74-4965 (KPERS and related public retirement systems) are added back. Subtraction (c)(xv): 529 contributions up to 3,000 / 6,000 joint per beneficiary (return-level only). KW-100 (US-KSS5-001): Kansas withholding applies to IRC 3401(a) wages subject to federal withholding; cafeteria/401(k) amounts follow the federal wage treatment

instrument_name: K.S.A. 44-710a Classification of employers; contribution rates (as amended by HB 2570)
authority: Kansas Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Rate computation only after 24 consecutive months chargeable; until then new employer rate 1.75% (construction 5.55%); employers new to Kansas since 2014-07-01 may elect the rate of their former state's reserve ratio (not less than 1%); experience schedules by reserve ratio (the schedule in effect each year is published by KDOL: 2026 Schedule C, 0%-6.95%)
